method: Streamed exact preserved ZIP stop_times into temporary disk-backed SQLite; compared current arrival (or departure if absent) with prior departure (or arrival if absent) after ordering by full trip_id and stop_sequence. Count summaries cover all rows; all affected trip IDs (168) are retained. The source ZIP remained read-only and the temporary spool was removed. Active service dates were derived from calendar.txt and calendar_dates.txt.
specObservation: GTFS Schedule reference defines stop_sequence as increasing along a trip and requires after-midnight service-day times to be encoded above 24:00:00; its stop_times table does not directly state a monotonic-time rule. MobilityData validator documentation describes a stop arrival preceding the prior departure as backwards time travel, but marks the historic validator rule deprecated. Treat these as distinct: raw evidence proves decreasing times by stop_sequence; the project gate still needs an explicit product policy.

suffixDateCoincidesWithActiveWindowDate.interpretation: diagnostic coincidence only; no suffix semantics assumed
